name: Office Analytics for Segment Analytics
description: Add OFC (Office) as a third cohort dimension in the Distribution tab alongside GEO and ADV. L1: top-9 advisors within an office. NNA: per-office period NNA. OFC is intended to ultimately replace ADV after stakeholder validation.
